papers.title: Masked Autoencoders with Limited Data: Does It Work? A Fine-Grained Bioacoustics Case Study
papers.authors: Wuao Liu, Mustafa Chasmai, Subhransu Maji, Grant Van Horn
papers.intro: 本文系统研究了掩码自编码器（MAE）在中等规模、弱标注的细粒度生物声学数据集（iNatSounds）上的预训练效果，发现预训练数据规模远比目标设计或额外领域特化预训练更重要，且领域特化继续预训练或选择性数据筛选带来的收益有限甚至为负。

papers.title: Unified Pix Token And Word Token Generative Language Model
papers.authors: Haun Leung, ZiNan Wang
papers.intro: 本文提出一种统一像素令牌（pix token）和文字令牌（word token）的生成式语言模型，通过为每个像素赋予独立可调的token embedding、颜色折叠、全局条件注意力近似和图像无监督预训练，实现了无需ViT编码器的视觉与语言统一生成。

papers.title: SenseNova-U1: Unifying Multimodal Understanding and Generation with NEO-unify Architecture
papers.authors: Haiwen Diao, Penghao Wu, Hanming Deng, Jiahao Wang, Shihao Bai, Silei Wu, Weichen Fan, Wenjie Ye, Wenwen Tong, Xiangyu Fan, Yan Li, Yubo Wang, Zhijie Cao, Zhiqian Lin, Zhitao Yang, Zhongang Cai, Yuwei Niu, Yue Zhu, Bo Liu, Chengguang Lv, Haojia Yu, Haozhe Xie, Hongli Wang, Jianan Fan, Jiaqi Li, Jiefan Lu, Jingcheng Ni, Junxiang Xu, Kaihuan Liang, Lianqiang Shi, Linjun Dai, Linyan Wang, Oscar Qian, Peng Gao, Pengfei Liu, Qingping Sun, Rui Shen, Ruisi Wang, Shengnan Ma, Shuang Yang, Siyi Xie, Siying Li, Tianbo Zhong, Xiangli Kong, Xuanke Shi, Yang Gao, Yongqiang Yao, Yves Wang, Zhengqi Bai, Zhengyu Lin, Zixin Yin, Wenxiu Sun, Ruihao Gong, Quan Wang, Lewei Lu, Lei Yang, Ziwei Liu, Dahua Lin
papers.affiliations: 未明确（论文正文第一页未提供作者机构信息）
papers.intro: SenseNova-U1基于NEO-unify架构，通过近无损视觉接口、原生端到端统一建模和原生混合物变换器（MoT）架构，首次实现无需预训练视觉编码器或VAE的理解-生成一体化多模态模型，在两个变体上达到甚至超越顶尖理解专用模型，同时具备强大的任意到图像合成、图文交错生成能力，并初步展现视觉-语言…

papers.title: CausalCine: Real-Time Autoregressive Generation for Multi-Shot Video Narratives
papers.authors: Yihao Meng, Zichen Liu, Hao Ouyang, Qiuyu Wang, Ka Leong Cheng, Yue Yu, Hanlin Wang, Haobo Li, Jiapeng Zhu, Yanhong Zeng, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Qifeng Chen, Huamin Qu
papers.intro: CausalCine是一个交互式自回归框架，通过先在原生多镜头序列上训练因果基模型、引入内容感知记忆路由（CAMR）以及蒸馏为少步生成器，实现了实时、流式的多镜头视频生成，支持在线提示更新和跨镜头一致性。

papers.title: Revisiting Photometric Ambiguity for Accurate Gaussian-Splatting Surface Reconstruction
papers.authors: Jiahe Li, Jiawei Zhang, Xiao Bai, Jin Zheng, Xiaohan Yu, Lin Gu, Gim Hee Lee
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, depth estimation, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: Beihang University, National University of Singapore, Macquarie University, Tohoku University
papers.intro: 本文提出AmbiSuR框架，通过揭示Gaussian Splatting中的两种内建原始级光度歧义并引入消歧策略，同时利用球谐系数作为免费歧义自指示器以引导先验正则化，从而在多种挑战场景下实现高精度的表面重建。

papers.title: Elastic Attention Cores for Scalable Vision Transformers
papers.authors: Alan Z. Song, Yinjie Chen, Mu Nan, Rui Zhang, Jiahang Cao, Weijian Mai, Muquan Yu, Hossein Adeli, Deva Ramanan, Michael J. Tarr, Andrew F. Luo
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, University of Hong Kong, Columbia University
papers.intro: 提出VECA（Visual Elastic Core Attention）架构，用核心-外围（core-periphery）结构的线性时间注意力替代全自注意力，并通过嵌套训练实现弹性计算-精度权衡，在不直接依赖补丁间交互的前提下达到与前沿视觉基础模型竞争的性能。

papers.title: ToolCUA: Towards Optimal GUI-Tool Path Orchestration for Computer Use Agents
papers.authors: Xuhao Hu, Xi Zhang, Haiyang Xu, Kyle Qiao, Jingyi Yang, Xuanjing Huang, Jing Shao, Ming Yan, Jieping Ye
papers.tags: gui, multimodal learning, visual grounding, edge deployment
papers.affiliations: Tongyi Lab, Alibaba Group（Xuhao Hu, Xi Zhang, Haiyang Xu, Kyle Qiao, Ming Yan, Jieping Ye）；Fudan University（Xuhao Hu, Jingyi Yang, Xuanjing Huang）；Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory（Jing Shao）
papers.intro: 本文提出ToolCUA，一种端到端代理，通过可扩展的交错GUI-工具轨迹合成和两阶段训练（工具引导的GUI监督与强化学习 + 在线强化学习）来学习最优GUI-工具路径选择，在OSWorld-MCP基准上达到新最优性能。

papers.title: OmniNFT: Modality-wise Omni Diffusion Reinforcement for Joint Audio-Video Generation
papers.authors: Guohui Zhang, XiaoXiao Ma, Jie Huang, Hang Xu, Hu Yu, Siming Fu, Yuming Li, Zeyue Xue, Lin Song, Haoyang Huang, Nan Duan, Feng Zhao
papers.tags: video generation, image generation, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: 未明确（多个机构：University of Science and Technology of China, Peking University, JD Explore Academy，但未在基本信息字段中明确列出，需在作者机构部分详细说明）
papers.intro: 提出OmniNFT，一种模态感知的在线扩散强化学习框架，通过模态级优势路由、层级梯度手术和区域级损失重加权，解决联合音频-视频生成中多目标优化不一致、梯度失衡和均匀信用分配问题，在JavisBench和VBench上显著提升感知质量、跨模态对齐和音视频同步。

papers.title: FuTCR: Future-Targeted Contrast and Repulsion for Continual Panoptic Segmentation
papers.authors: Nicholas Ikechukwu, Keanu Nichols, Deepti Ghadiyaram, Bryan A. Plummer
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, Mask Generation, object detection
papers.intro: FuTCR 提出一种未来目标对比与排斥框架，通过利用模型自身预测发现未来类区域，并对其施加像素-区域对比学习和已知类排斥损失，在持续全景分割中显著提升新类性能并保持旧类性能。

papers.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Efficient Retrospective Dynamic Scene Novel View Synthesis with a Standardized Benchmark
papers.authors: Yunxiao Zhang, Suryansh Kumar
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, image generation, Video to Video, image-to-image
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于3DGS的免时间形变约束的回顾性动态场景新视角合成方法，通过逐帧热启动优化和固定高斯预算实现高效渲染，并附带一个基于Blender的标准化动态多视角数据集框架以支持复现性基准测试。

papers.title: GaitProtector: Impersonation-Driven Gait De-Identification via Training-Free Diffusion Latent Optimization
papers.authors: Huiran Duan, Qian Zhou, Zhongliang Guo, Junhao Dong, Yuqi Li, Guoying Zhao, Yingli Tian
papers.tags: image generation, Video to Video, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: City University of New York, USA (Huiran Duan, Yuqi Li, Yingli Tian); Wuhan University, China (Qian Zhou); University of Aberdeen, UK (Zhongliang Guo); Nanyang Technological University, Singapore (Junhao Dong); ELLIS Institute Finland, University of Oulu, Finland (Guoying Zhao)
papers.intro: 本文提出GaitProtector，一种无需训练的视频扩散潜空间优化框架，通过结合混淆（repel源身份）和冒充（attract目标身份）的联合目标，在预训练3D扩散先验的引导下生成结构合理的受保护步态轮廓序列。

papers.title: AOI-SSL: Self-Supervised Framework for Efficient Segmentation of Wire-bonded Semiconductors In Optical Inspection
papers.authors: Joaquín Figueira, Rob Van Gastel, Giacomo D'Amicantonio, Zhuoran Liu, Ioan Gabriel Bucur, Faysal Boughorbel, Egor Bondarev
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, Image Feature Extraction, Mask Generation
papers.affiliations: AIMS Lab, Eindhoven University of Technology；CoC, ASMPT；iCIS, Radboud University
papers.intro: 本文提出AOI-SSL框架，通过在小域自监督预训练中优选掩码自编码器（MAE），结合免训练的检索式分割，实现双通道单色线焊半导体图像的语义分割，大幅减少标注需求并加速适应新设备。

papers.title: Executable Agentic Memory for GUI Agent
papers.authors: Zerui Qin, Sheng Yue, Xingyuan Hua, Yongjian Fu, Ju Ren
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua University, China; Sun Yat-sen University, China
papers.intro: 本文提出可执行智能体记忆（EAM），通过构建结构化的GUI逻辑知识图谱，将GUI规划从自由生成转变为基于轻量Q模型引导MCTS的检索-执行过程，在多个基准上显著提升成功率并降低成本和延迟。

papers.title: Multimodal Abstractive Summarization of Instructional Videos with Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Maham Nazir, Muhammad Aqeel, Richong Zhang, Francesco Setti
papers.tags: multimodal learning, CLIP, image captioning, video search
papers.affiliations: Beihang University, Beijing, China; University of Verona, Italy
papers.intro: 本文提出ClipSum框架，利用冻结的CLIP视觉-语言特征与BART文本生成模型结合，通过显式时间建模和维度自适应跨模态融合，在YouCook2教学视频摘要任务上超越了传统CNN特征方法，并发现冻结CLIP优于微调CLIP。

papers.title: CaC: Advancing Video Reward Models via Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Concentrating
papers.authors: Jiyuan Wang, Huan Ouyang, Jiuzhou Lin, Chunyu Lin, Dewen Fan, Boheng Zhang, Haonan Fan, Fei Zuo, Jia Sun, Huaiqing Wang, Honglie Wang, Yiyang Fan, Zhenlong Yuan, Zijun Li, Yongrui Heng, Guosheng Lin, Fan Yang, Tingting Gao
papers.affiliations: 北京交通大学（BJTU）、南洋理工大学（NTU）、北京邮电大学（BUPT）、快手科技（Kuaishou Technology）
papers.intro: CaC提出了一种基于VLM的粗到细两轮视频奖励模型，通过先全局时间扫描定位异常时间窗、再在局部时间窗内进行空间细粒度定位，并结合结构化时空Chain-of-Thought推理，实现对生成视频中稀疏异常的可解释检测，同时可作为奖励信号降低下游生成视频的异常率。

papers.title: Power Reinforcement Post-Training of Text-to-Image Models with Super-Linear Advantage Shaping
papers.authors: Haoyuan Sun, Jing Wang, Yuxin Song, Yu Lu, Bo Fang, Yifu Luo, Jun Yin, Pengyu Zeng, Miao Zhang, Tiantian Zhang, Xueqian Wang, Shijian Lu
papers.tags: text-to-image, image generation, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: Nanyang Technological University, Baidu Inc., Zhejiang University, City University of Hong Kong, Tsinghua University, Jimei University
papers.intro: 本文提出超线性优势塑形（SLAS）方法，从信息几何角度扩展Fisher-Rao度量，引入优势依赖的非线性几何结构来重塑局部策略空间，从而放大高优势方向、抑制低优势噪音梯度，有效缓解文本到图像模型强化学习后训练中的奖励黑客问题。

papers.title: Personal Visual Context Learning in Large Multimodal Models
papers.authors: Zihui Xue, Ami Baid, Sangho Kim, Mi Luo, Kristen Grauman
papers.affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin
papers.intro: 本文形式化了“个人视觉上下文学习”（Personal VCL）任务，构建了对应基准（Personal-VCL-Bench），揭示当前LMM在利用视觉证据和聚合多观察结果方面存在严重不足，并提出了一种推理时基线方法（Agentic Context Bank），通过结构化的记忆库和查询自适应选择来提升性…

papers.title: Pixal3D: Pixel-Aligned 3D Generation from Images
papers.authors: Dong-Yang Li, Wang Zhao, Yuxin Chen, Wenbo Hu, Meng-Hao Guo, Fang-Lue Zhang, Ying Shan, Shi-Min Hu
papers.affiliations: 清华大学（BNRist, 计算机科学与技术系）、腾讯ARC Lab、惠灵顿维多利亚大学
papers.intro: Pixal3D提出一种像素对齐的3D生成范式，通过射线反投影机制显式建立2D-3D对应，替代交叉注意力，显著提升了图像到3D生成的保真度，并自然扩展到多视图生成与场景合成。

papers.title: Confidence-Guided Diffusion Augmentation for Enhanced Bangla Compound Character Recognition
papers.authors: Md. Sultan Al Rayhan, Maheen Islam
papers.intro: 本文提出一种置信度引导的扩散增强框架，结合类别条件扩散模型、分类器引导、SE增强残差块和置信度过滤机制，生成高质量合成孟加拉语复合字符图像，显著提升低资源下的识别性能。

papers.title: Counterfactual Stress Testing for Image Classification Models
papers.authors: Moritz Stammel, Fabio De Sousa Ribeiro, Raghav Mehta, Mélanie Roschewitz, Ben Glocker
papers.affiliations: Department of Computing, Imperial College London, UK
papers.intro: 提出一种基于因果生成模型（DSCM）的反事实压力测试框架，通过干预图像属性（扫描仪类型、患者性别）生成真实的反事实图像，相较于经典扰动方法能更准确地预测模型在实际分布偏移下的性能变化、幅度和模型排序。
